title: Eve of the Storm
next_chapter_hook: As Chen Ji turned and walked away, the blood characters on the chessboard fragment shifted silently: 'The game is set, who is the chess player?' The bells of Xuanwu Sect rang thunderously, and a storm sweeping across the world was about to begin from this very night.

text.content: On the fragment, blood characters burned like branding irons. Seven crimson characters floated above Chen Ji's palm—'Chapter Seven Hundred, the Deadly Game Begins.' His pupils contracted, yet there was not a trace of panic. On the contrary, in those eyes that usually hid timidity, a cold flame ignited. A deadly game? He murmured in his heart. Since the Tianji Record demands his death, then he would turn this deadly game into everyone's deadly game.

dialogue.content: Those blood characters... are they prophecy? Su Qingyao had somehow appeared at Chen Ji's side, her voice barely a whisper yet trembling uncontrollably. She had witnessed Chen Ji's countless times of playing the fool before striking, but the crimson characters hovering in his palm now were unmistakably—a declaration of war against fate itself.

text.content: Chen Ji slowly closed his palm, the blood characters dissolving like mist. He surveyed his surroundings—the ruins of the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion, the lingering shadow of former Elder Ling Yuan, Han Lie's overbearing presence, and the unseen Heavenly Eye lurking somewhere. A massive net was closing in on him, but the tighter the net, the more vulnerabilities it contained. He had waited for this moment far too long.

dialogue.content: The demonic mist's concealment was failing rapidly. Ye Qing's voice emerged from the shadows, carrying an unusual gravity. Ling Yuan and Han Lie had formed an alliance, and the intensity of the imperial succession struggle was escalating beyond all expectations. She paused—the timing of the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion's exposure was too convenient, as if someone was deliberately manipulating events from behind the scenes.

text.content: Chen Ji nodded. The chessboard fragment suddenly blazed with heat as a golden page emerged from the torn Tianji Record—the fifth page. Mo Xiansheng's final gift, preserved before his disappearance, resonated with Chen Ji's bloodline at this critical moment. The page unfurled slowly, revealing ancient seal script: 'Fate's Scribe—using lifespan as ink, one can inscribe a quarter-hour of the future.' The price was life itself. Chen Ji smiled, his expression sharp and resolute.

choice.prompt: The fifth page of the Tianji Record, 'Fate's Scribe', had been unlocked. Confronted with the approaching storm, Chen Ji faced a critical decision—should he restart his strategy, retreating to advance? Or should he directly engage, using attack as his form of defense?

choices.description: Utilize the Fate's Scribe ability to reweave the chess game before the storm arrives. Retreat to advance, drawing all enemies into an even deeper trap.
choices.visible_reward: Gain Comprehensive Foresight of the Storm's Trajectory for Three Days
choices.risk_hint: The lifespan consumption is irreversible, but it trades for absolute strategic advantage.

text.content: Chen Ji bit his fingertip, using blood as ink to write on the fifth page. His lifespan drained away like flowing water, yet his eyes grew increasingly bright. Three days—he had three days to see all the trajectories. Where Ling Yuan would strike, when Han Lie would make his move, even where the Heavenly Eye's tendrils would extend... everything became as clear as a chess manual.

He saw it. Seven days later at Xuanwu Sect, at the critical moment of imperial succession, all forces would gather. That was the battlefield he had long prepared, and also the trap where Ling Yuan had buried his killing move. But this time, he was not the prey, but the chess player.

choices.description: No longer hiding, announcing his return with his true self. Faking death was now past. He wanted to tell the world—Chen Ji, never died.
choices.risk_hint: Will provoke the joint suppression of Ling Yuan and Han Lie, but also prevent enemies from scheming in the shadows

dialogue.content: Not necessary. Chen Ji's voice suddenly rose, carrying unprecedented boldness. Su Qingyao, Ye Qing, follow me to Xuanwu Sect. A cold smile curved his lips—since they wanted to witness Chen Ji's death, he would show them how terrifying Chen Ji, resurrected from the dead, could truly be.

text.content: Three silhouettes tore through the air, leaving a trail of shock. Chen Ji, the Outer Disciple/Servant from Tianqing Sect—the laughingstock everyone had mocked—had actually issued a challenge to Xuanwu Sect? The news spread like wildfire, and the entire cultivation world erupted.

The chessboard fragment suddenly blazed with heat as information flooded Chen Ji's mind—Chen Tianming, deep within the spacetime rift. His sister, missing for years, held by the Holy Sect as a 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key.' Her location was now locked, but the conditions to reach her remained uncertain. Chen Ji's grip on the chessboard tightened, his knuckles white.

dialogue.content: Foolish creature. The former Elder's pressure bore down like a mountain, his voice echoing through the void. Chen Ji, do you think breaking through to Foundation Building makes you my equal? Killing intent flickered in Ling Yuan's eyes. The imperial succession struggle was merely an appetizer—the true game... you haven't even glimpsed its full scope.

text.content: Chen Ji raised his head, meeting that crushing pressure directly. His spine straightened resolutely. Trash? Old Elder, from the moment the Tianji Record abandoned you, you ceased being a chess piece. He laughed, utterly unruffled. Now... you're not even worth being a piece. At most, you're just an abacus bead—easily manipulated by others.

dialogue.content: Han Lie's roar came from the horizon, the Xuanwu Sect's secret techniques pushed to the extreme, causing the Void itself to tremble. Chen Ji!! How dare you plant your banner at my Xuanwu Sect? His fist carried world-destroying might as it crashed toward Chen Ji, yet a piece of chessboard fragment that appeared out of nowhere absorbed all of it.

text.content: "You'll never understand, Han Lie." Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly calm. "You think power can solve everything, but you don't know the true power—it's the wisdom that brings despair." He stretched out his hand, pointing toward the highest peak of the Xuanwu Sect, where a banner with black background and golden characters had already been erected, fluttering violently in the wind.

choice.prompt: The banner has been planted. Facing the fury of Han Lie, the number one genius of the Xuanwu Sect, how will Chen Ji respond?

choices.description: Use words to humiliate Han Lie to the extreme, making him lose his senses publicly and lose face in front of everyone.
choices.visible_reward: Han Lie Loses His Composure Publicly, Reputation Skyrockets
choices.risk_hint: Han Lie Might Unleash Forbidden Techniques Without Regard for Consequences

dialogue.content: Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, his gaze like watching a clown perform. "Han Lie, the number one genius of the Xuanwu Sect?" His voice wasn't loud, yet it clearly reached everyone's ears. "I remember three years ago, you stood before me with that same confidence. And the result?" He smiled faintly. "The current you... is even more foolish than back then."

text.content: Han Lie's face turned liver-colored. His sanity was on the verge of collapse, the spiritual artifact in his hand trembling violently. Countless cultivators around whispered—Han Lie, the number one genius of the Xuanwu Sect, pushed to this state by a trash through words alone? This battle, Han Lie had already lost.

choices.description: Disdain to speak more with Han Lie, prove everything through action. Let the enemy understand they are not even qualified to be Chen Ji's opponents.
choices.visible_reward: Display Absolute Confidence, Shocking the Entire Audience
choices.risk_hint: Enemy Might Think the Protagonist Is Afraid

text.content: Chen Ji simply glanced at Han Lie coldly, then turned and walked away. There was no mockery in that gaze, no anger, only a chilling indifference that made people's spines tingle. It was like looking at an ant—unworthy of wasting another word. This kind of disregard was more devastating than any humiliation.

Han Lie stood frozen in place. He wanted to chase after him, but found himself unable to move a single step. It wasn't fear, but a deeper layer of defeat—he realized that no matter how hard he pursued, this person would always stand at a height he could never reach.

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao watched Chen Ji's retreating figure, her heart full of mixed emotions. She had countless times tried to uncover this man's true face, yet every time he skillfully dissolved her attempts. But at this moment, gazing at the banner fluttering in the wind, she suddenly understood—this man was never any kind of waste.

text.content: From now on, it's no longer faking death. Chen Ji's voice echoed across the skies of the Xuanwu Sect, carrying a kind of desperate resolve. "But rather—true rebirth." He turned around, the setting sun stretching his shadow extremely long, as if it would devour the entire world. Chapter Seven Hundred, he silently recited in his heart, I await you at the finish line.

choice.prompt: The Rebirth Declaration Has Been Issued. Next, Chen Ji needs to choose his next move—search for his sister Chen Nian, or deal with the threat from Ling Yuan first?

choices.description: Sister Chen Nian is the Heavenly Fate Lock Key, her existence can interfere with the Tianji Record's foresight. Finding her is the key to unraveling all mysteries.
choices.visible_cost: Temporarily Lay Down Caution Against Ling Yuan
choices.visible_reward: Unlock New Plot Lines, Obtain Key Clues to Counter the Eye of Heavenly Fate
choices.risk_hint: A Trap from the Holy Sect Might Be Waiting for Him

text.content: The chessboard fragment pointed to the deepest part of the spacetime rift. Chen Nian's aura flickered in and out of visibility. Chen Ji clenched his fist—the sister who had been missing for years was his only kin in this world. Whether ahead lay dragon's pool or tiger's den, he had to go.

But just as he was about to set out, the fifth page of the Tianji Record suddenly shook violently. A blurry image emerged—Chen Nian trapped in chaos, surrounded by countless chains. The chains were covered in characters from the Eye of Heavenly Providence. She was not a prisoner... She was the key.

choices.description: Ling Yuan is the greatest hidden danger. He must be eradicated before he completes his arrangements. This is a decapitation strike—once and for all.
choices.visible_reward: Eliminate the greatest internal threat of the Tianqing Sect, deter all enemies
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan's strength is unfathomable. Acting rashly may lead to a bitter battle

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan must die. A murderous glint flashed in Chen Ji's eyes. The old sect master's ambition was no longer concealed. Rather than waiting for him to complete his layout, it was better to strike first. He turned to look at Su Qingyao. Qingyao, within the Tianqing Sect... how many people can we trust?

text.content: Su Qingyao was silent for a moment before finally nodding. Three tenths. She whispered, but that's enough. Enough for what? She didn't finish, but Chen Ji already understood. Enough to make Ling Yuan feel what it means to have everyone turn against him at the crucial moment.

The night deepened, and the bells of the Xuanwu Sect echoed hauntingly. Chen Ji stood at the highest peak, gazing down at the colossal structure beneath his feet. The black banner with golden characters fluttered behind him, its words gleaming brilliantly under the moonlight—'Chapter Seven Hundred, I await you at the finish line.'

The wind lifted his robes, and Chen Ji suddenly remembered something. He looked down at the chessboard fragment in his palm—the seven blood-red characters remained. But beside them, a line of small text had appeared: 'The chess game is set, but who is the chess player?' He gently traced the words, a meaningful smile curling at his lips.

dialogue.content: The Demon Path Saint's voice came from behind, carrying a rare hint of teasing. The Tianji Pavilion destroyed, the Eye of Heavenly Providence revealed, Ling Yuan and Han Lie joining forces, the imperial succession dispute heating up... Your troubles are even more numerous than I imagined. She smiled lightly. Would you like the Holy Demon Sect to share some of the burden?

text.content: Chen Ji didn't turn around. Not yet. He murmured, let the bullet fly a while longer. The storm was coming, and he... was standing right at the eye of the storm. The blood-red characters on the chessboard fragment changed once more—this time showing a blurry image. A figure wrapped in chains, an existence beyond the mortal world, and a pair of eyes... that were watching from here.

dialogue.content: Those eyes had no physical form, yet they seemed capable of piercing through time and space. They looked in Chen Ji's direction, without anger, without threat, only an emotion-surpassing... indifference. Chen Ji felt a bone-deep chill. He knew what it was—the Eye of Heavenly Providence. It was gazing at one of the countless chess pieces it had maneuvered over millennia... its newest piece.

text.content: But Chen Ji did not retreat. He faced that transcendent gaze, a sharp curve forming at the corner of his mouth. So what if it's the Eye of Heavenly Providence? He murmured, his voice only audible to himself. Since you want to play chess, I'll play this game to the end. Chapter Seven Hundred—I will be there, and I will personally overturn this entire board.

He turned, looking toward the east. There lay the direction of the Tianqing Sect, the lair where Ling Yuan lurked; there also was the imperial court center, the vortex of the succession struggle; and there was also a torn spacetime rift, the prison where his sister was trapped. And he, Chen Ji, once a waste, now stood at the center of all this, preparing to throw the entire world... into chaos.

The banner fluttered loudly in the wind. Moonlight fell, making those golden characters gleam brilliantly. Chapter Seven Hundred, I await you at the finish line. This was a declaration of war, and a promise. Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, black hair flying in the wind, eyes burning with indomitable fighting spirit. The storm was coming, and he— was the creator of this storm.
